newsitem.title: USA: Treasury's Rubin names new chief of staff.
newsitem.headline: Treasury's Rubin names new chief of staff.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin announced on Wednesday that Michael Froman has been named Chief of Staff of the Treasury Department, replacing Sylvia Mathews.

Froman has been the Treasury's deputy assistant secretary for Eurasia and the Middle East in the Office of International Affairs since December 1995. Prior to that, he held senior positions at the National Economic Council and the National Security Council at the White House.
Rubin also named Sandra Mancini as Deputy Chief of Staff. She has been at Treasury since July 1994 and is currently senior advisor to the Chief of Staff and White House liason.
